70static int32_t write_cached_secondary_ddt(aaruformat_context *ctx)
71{
72 // Flux-only images carry no DDT.
73 if(ctx->no_user_data_ddt) return AARUF_STATUS_OK;
74
75 // Only a table modified since it was loaded or created needs writing
76 if(!ctx->dirty_secondary_ddt || ctx->cached_secondary_ddt2 == NULL) return AARUF_STATUS_OK;
77
78 TRACE("Writing cached secondary DDT table to file");
79
80 const int32_t res = flush_cached_secondary_ddt_v2(ctx);
81 if(res != AARUF_STATUS_OK) return AARUF_ERROR_CANNOT_WRITE_HEADER;
82
83 return AARUF_STATUS_OK;
84}

103static int32_t write_primary_ddt(aaruformat_context *ctx)
104{
105 // Flux-only images carry no DDT.
106 if(ctx->no_user_data_ddt) return AARUF_STATUS_OK;
107
108 // Write the cached primary DDT table back to its position in the file
109 if(ctx->user_data_ddt_header.tableShift <= 0 || ctx->user_data_ddt2 == NULL) return AARUF_STATUS_OK;
110
111 TRACE("Writing cached primary DDT table back to file");
112
113 // Calculate CRC64 of the primary DDT table data first
114 crc64_ctx *crc64_context = aaruf_crc64_init();
115 if(crc64_context != NULL)
116 {
117 size_t primary_table_size = ctx->user_data_ddt_header.entries * sizeof(uint64_t);
118
119 aaruf_crc64_update(crc64_context, (uint8_t *)ctx->user_data_ddt2, primary_table_size);
120
121 uint64_t crc64;
122 aaruf_crc64_final(crc64_context, &crc64);
123
124 // Properly populate all header fields for multi-level DDT primary table
125 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.identifier = DeDuplicationTable2;
126 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.type = kDataTypeUserData;
127 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.compression = kCompressionNone;
128 // levels, tableLevel, previousLevelOffset, negative, overflow, blockAlignmentShift,
129 // dataShift, tableShift, sizeType, entries, blocks, start are already set during creation
130 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.crc64 = crc64;
131 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.cmpCrc64 = crc64;
132 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.length = primary_table_size;
133 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.cmpLength = primary_table_size;
134
135 TRACE("Calculated CRC64 for primary DDT: 0x%16lX", crc64);
136 }
137
138 // Free CRC64 context
139 aaruf_crc64_free(crc64_context);
140
141 // First write the DDT header
142 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, (aaru_off_t)ctx->primary_ddt_offset, SEEK_SET);
143
144 size_t headerWritten = fwrite(&ctx->user_data_ddt_header, sizeof(DdtHeader2), 1, ctx->imageStream);
145 if(headerWritten != 1)
146 {
147 TRACE("Failed to write primary DDT header to file");
148 return AARUF_ERROR_CANNOT_WRITE_HEADER;
149 }
150
151 // Then write the table data (position is already after the header)
152 size_t primary_table_size = ctx->user_data_ddt_header.entries * sizeof(uint64_t);
153
154 // Write the primary table data
155 size_t written_bytes = 0;
156 written_bytes = fwrite(ctx->user_data_ddt2, primary_table_size, 1, ctx->imageStream);
157
158 if(written_bytes == 1)
159 {
160 TRACE("Successfully wrote primary DDT header and table to file (%" PRIu64 " entries, %zu bytes)",
161 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.entries, primary_table_size);
162
163 // Remove any previously existing index entries of the same type before adding
164 TRACE("Removing any previously existing primary DDT index entries");
165 for(int k = utarray_len(ctx->index_entries) - 1; k >= 0; k--)
166 {
167 const IndexEntry *entry = (IndexEntry *)utarray_eltptr(ctx->index_entries, k);
168 if(entry && entry->blockType == DeDuplicationTable2 && entry->dataType == kDataTypeUserData)
169 {
170 TRACE("Found existing primary DDT index entry at position %d, removing", k);
171 utarray_erase(ctx->index_entries, k, 1);
172 }
173 }
174
175 // Add primary DDT to index
176 TRACE("Adding primary DDT to index");
177 IndexEntry primary_ddt_entry;
178 primary_ddt_entry.blockType = DeDuplicationTable2;
179 primary_ddt_entry.dataType = kDataTypeUserData;
180 primary_ddt_entry.offset = ctx->primary_ddt_offset;
181
182 utarray_push_back(ctx->index_entries, &primary_ddt_entry);
183 ctx->dirty_index_block = true;
184 TRACE("Added primary DDT index entry at offset %" PRIu64, ctx->primary_ddt_offset);
185 }
186 else
187 TRACE("Failed to write primary DDT table to file");
188
189 return AARUF_STATUS_OK;
190}

208static int32_t write_single_level_ddt(aaruformat_context *ctx)
209{
210 // Flux-only images carry no DDT.
211 if(ctx->no_user_data_ddt) return AARUF_STATUS_OK;
212
213 // Write the single level DDT table block aligned just after the header
214 if(ctx->user_data_ddt_header.tableShift != 0 || ctx->user_data_ddt2 == NULL) return AARUF_STATUS_OK;
215
216 TRACE("Writing single-level DDT table to file");
217
218 // Calculate CRC64 of the primary DDT table data
219 const size_t primary_table_size = ctx->user_data_ddt_header.entries * sizeof(uint64_t);
220
221 // Properly populate all header fields
222 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.identifier = DeDuplicationTable2;
223 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.type = kDataTypeUserData;
224 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.compression =
225 ctx->compression_enabled ? (ctx->use_zstd ? kCompressionZstd : kCompressionLzma) : kCompressionNone;
226 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.levels = 1; // Single level
227 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.tableLevel = 0; // Top level
228 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.previousLevelOffset = 0; // No previous level for single-level DDT
229 // negative and overflow are already set during creation
230 // blockAlignmentShift, dataShift, tableShift, sizeType, entries, blocks, start are already set
231 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.length = primary_table_size;
232 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.cmpLength = primary_table_size;
233
234 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.crc64 = aaruf_crc64_data((uint8_t *)ctx->user_data_ddt2, primary_table_size);
235
236 TRACE("Calculated CRC64 for single-level DDT: 0x%16lX", ctx->user_data_ddt_header.crc64);
237
238 uint8_t *cmp_buffer = NULL;
239 uint8_t lzma_properties[LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH] = {0};
240
241 if(ctx->user_data_ddt_header.compression == kCompressionNone)
242 {
243
244 cmp_buffer = (uint8_t *)ctx->user_data_ddt2;
245 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.cmpCrc64 = ctx->user_data_ddt_header.crc64;
246 }
247 else
248 {
249 cmp_buffer = malloc((size_t)ctx->user_data_ddt_header.length * 2); // Allocate double size for compression
250 if(cmp_buffer == NULL)
251 {
252 TRACE("Failed to allocate memory for secondary DDT v2 compression");
253 return AARUF_ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY;
254 }
255
256 size_t dst_size;
257
258 if(ctx->use_zstd)
259 {
260 dst_size = aaruf_zstd_encode_buffer(cmp_buffer, (size_t)ctx->user_data_ddt_header.length * 2,
261 (uint8_t *)ctx->user_data_ddt2, ctx->user_data_ddt_header.length,
262 ctx->zstd_level, ctx->num_threads);
263 if(dst_size == 0) dst_size = ctx->user_data_ddt_header.length; // fall through to None
264 }
265 else
266 {
267 dst_size = (size_t)ctx->user_data_ddt_header.length * 2 * 2;
268 size_t props_size = LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH;
269 aaruf_lzma_encode_buffer(cmp_buffer, &dst_size, (uint8_t *)ctx->user_data_ddt2,
270 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.length, lzma_properties, &props_size, 9,
271 ctx->lzma_dict_size, 4, 0, 2, 273, LZMA_THREADS(ctx));
272 }
273
274 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.cmpLength = (uint32_t)dst_size;
275
276 if(ctx->user_data_ddt_header.cmpLength >= ctx->user_data_ddt_header.length)
277 {
278 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.compression = kCompressionNone;
279 free(cmp_buffer);
280
281 cmp_buffer = (uint8_t *)ctx->user_data_ddt2;
282 }
283 }
284
285 if(ctx->user_data_ddt_header.compression == kCompressionNone)
286 {
287 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.cmpLength = ctx->user_data_ddt_header.length;
288 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.cmpCrc64 = ctx->user_data_ddt_header.crc64;
289 }
290 else
291 {
292 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.cmpCrc64 =
293 aaruf_crc64_data(cmp_buffer, (uint32_t)ctx->user_data_ddt_header.cmpLength);
294 if(ctx->use_zstd) ctx->has_zstd_blocks = true;
295 }
296
297 if(ctx->user_data_ddt_header.compression == kCompressionLzma)
298 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.cmpLength += LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH;
299
300 // Write the DDT header first
301 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, 0, SEEK_END);
302 aaru_off_t ddt_position = aaruf_ftell(ctx->imageStream);
303 // Align index position to block boundary if needed
304 const uint64_t alignment_mask = (1ULL << ctx->user_data_ddt_header.blockAlignmentShift) - 1;
305 if(ddt_position & alignment_mask)
306 {
307 const uint64_t aligned_position = ddt_position + alignment_mask & ~alignment_mask;
308 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, aligned_position, SEEK_SET);
309 ddt_position = aligned_position;
310 }
311
312 const size_t header_written = fwrite(&ctx->user_data_ddt_header, sizeof(DdtHeader2), 1, ctx->imageStream);
313 if(header_written != 1)
314 {
315 TRACE("Failed to write single-level DDT header to file");
316 return AARUF_ERROR_CANNOT_WRITE_HEADER;
317 }
318
319 // Write the primary table data
320 size_t written_bytes = 0;
321 if(ctx->user_data_ddt_header.compression == kCompressionLzma)
322 fwrite(lzma_properties, LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH, 1, ctx->imageStream);
323
324 written_bytes = fwrite(cmp_buffer, ctx->user_data_ddt_header.cmpLength, 1, ctx->imageStream);
325
326 if(written_bytes == 1)
327 {
328 TRACE("Successfully wrote single-level DDT header and table to file (%" PRIu64
329 " entries, %zu bytes, %zu compressed bytes)",
330 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.entries, ctx->user_data_ddt_header.length, ctx->user_data_ddt_header.cmpLength);
331
332 // Remove any previously existing index entries of the same type before adding
333 TRACE("Removing any previously existing single-level DDT index entries");
334 for(int k = utarray_len(ctx->index_entries) - 1; k >= 0; k--)
335 {
336 const IndexEntry *entry = (IndexEntry *)utarray_eltptr(ctx->index_entries, k);
337 if(entry && entry->blockType == DeDuplicationTable2 && entry->dataType == kDataTypeUserData)
338 {
339 TRACE("Found existing single-level DDT index entry at position %d, removing", k);
340 utarray_erase(ctx->index_entries, k, 1);
341 }
342 }
343
344 // Add single-level DDT to index
345 TRACE("Adding single-level DDT to index");
346 IndexEntry single_ddt_entry;
347 single_ddt_entry.blockType = DeDuplicationTable2;
348 single_ddt_entry.dataType = kDataTypeUserData;
349 single_ddt_entry.offset = ddt_position;
350
351 utarray_push_back(ctx->index_entries, &single_ddt_entry);
352 ctx->dirty_index_block = true;
353 TRACE("Added single-level DDT index entry at offset %" PRIu64, ddt_position);
354 }
355 else
356 TRACE("Failed to write single-level DDT table data to file");
357
358 // Free compression buffer if it was allocated
359 if(ctx->user_data_ddt_header.compression != kCompressionNone && cmp_buffer != (uint8_t *)ctx->user_data_ddt2)
360 free(cmp_buffer);
361
362 return AARUF_STATUS_OK;
363}

472static int32_t write_tape_ddt(aaruformat_context *ctx)
473{
474 if(!ctx->is_tape) return AARUF_STATUS_INVALID_CONTEXT;
475
476 // Flux-only images carry no DDT (defensive; tape images aren't flux-only today).
477 if(ctx->no_user_data_ddt) return AARUF_STATUS_OK;
478
479 // Traverse the tape DDT uthash and find the biggest key
480 uint64_t max_key = 0;
481 TapeDdtHashEntry *entry, *tmp;
482 HASH_ITER(hh, ctx->tape_ddt, entry, tmp)
483 if(entry->key > max_key) max_key = entry->key;
484
485 // Initialize context user data DDT header
486 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.identifier = DeDuplicationTable2;
487 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.type = kDataTypeUserData;
488 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.compression =
489 ctx->compression_enabled ? (ctx->use_zstd ? kCompressionZstd : kCompressionLzma) : kCompressionNone;
490 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.levels = 1; // Single level
491 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.tableLevel = 0; // Top level
492 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.previousLevelOffset = 0; // No previous level for single-level DDT
493 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.negative = 0;
494 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.overflow = 0;
495 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.tableShift = 0; // Single level
496 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.entries = max_key + 1;
497 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.blocks = max_key + 1;
498 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.start = 0;
499 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.length = ctx->user_data_ddt_header.entries * sizeof(uint64_t);
500 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.cmpLength = ctx->user_data_ddt_header.length;
501
502 // Initialize memory for user data DDT
503 ctx->user_data_ddt2 = calloc(ctx->user_data_ddt_header.entries, sizeof(uint64_t));
504 if(ctx->user_data_ddt2 == NULL)
505 {
506 TRACE("Failed to allocate memory for tape DDT table");
507 return AARUF_ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY;
508 }
509
510 // Populate user data DDT from tape DDT uthash
511 HASH_ITER(hh, ctx->tape_ddt, entry, tmp)
512 if(entry->key < ctx->user_data_ddt_header.blocks) ctx->user_data_ddt2[entry->key] = entry->value;
513
514 // Do not repeat code
515 return write_single_level_ddt(ctx);
516}

534static void write_checksum_block(aaruformat_context *ctx)
535{
536 uint64_t alignment_mask;
537 uint64_t aligned_position;
538
539 // Finalize pending checksums
540 if(ctx->calculating_md5)
541 {
542 ctx->checksums.hasMd5 = true;
543 aaruf_md5_final(&ctx->md5_context, ctx->checksums.md5);
544 }
545 if(ctx->calculating_sha1)
546 {
547 ctx->checksums.hasSha1 = true;
548 aaruf_sha1_final(&ctx->sha1_context, ctx->checksums.sha1);
549 }
550 if(ctx->calculating_sha256)
551 {
552 ctx->checksums.hasSha256 = true;
553 aaruf_sha256_final(&ctx->sha256_context, ctx->checksums.sha256);
554 }
555 if(ctx->calculating_spamsum)
556 {
557 ctx->checksums.hasSpamSum = true;
558 ctx->checksums.spamsum = calloc(1, FUZZY_MAX_RESULT);
559 aaruf_spamsum_final(ctx->spamsum_context, ctx->checksums.spamsum);
560 aaruf_spamsum_free(ctx->spamsum_context);
561 }
562 if(ctx->calculating_blake3)
563 {
564 ctx->checksums.hasBlake3 = true;
565 blake3_hasher_finalize(ctx->blake3_context, ctx->checksums.blake3, BLAKE3_OUT_LEN);
566 free(ctx->blake3_context);
567 }
568
569 // Write the checksums block
570 bool has_checksums = ctx->checksums.hasMd5 || ctx->checksums.hasSha1 || ctx->checksums.hasSha256 ||
571 ctx->checksums.hasSpamSum || ctx->checksums.hasBlake3;
572
573 if(!has_checksums) return;
574
575 ChecksumHeader checksum_header = {0};
576 checksum_header.identifier = ChecksumBlock;
577
578 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, 0, SEEK_END);
579 aaru_off_t checksum_position = aaruf_ftell(ctx->imageStream);
580 // Align index position to block boundary if needed
581 alignment_mask = (1ULL << ctx->user_data_ddt_header.blockAlignmentShift) - 1;
582 if(checksum_position & alignment_mask)
583 {
584 aligned_position = checksum_position + alignment_mask & ~alignment_mask;
585 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, aligned_position, SEEK_SET);
586 checksum_position = aligned_position;
587 }
588
589 // Skip checksum_header
590 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, sizeof(checksum_header), SEEK_CUR);
591
592 if(ctx->checksums.hasMd5)
593 {
594 TRACE("Writing MD5 checksum entry");
595 ChecksumEntry md5_entry = {0};
596 md5_entry.length = MD5_DIGEST_LENGTH;
597 md5_entry.type = Md5;
598 fwrite(&md5_entry, sizeof(ChecksumEntry), 1, ctx->imageStream);
599 fwrite(&ctx->checksums.md5, MD5_DIGEST_LENGTH, 1, ctx->imageStream);
600 checksum_header.length += sizeof(ChecksumEntry) + MD5_DIGEST_LENGTH;
601 checksum_header.entries++;
602 }
603
604 if(ctx->checksums.hasSha1)
605 {
606 TRACE("Writing SHA1 checksum entry");
607 ChecksumEntry sha1_entry = {0};
608 sha1_entry.length = SHA1_DIGEST_LENGTH;
609 sha1_entry.type = Sha1;
610 fwrite(&sha1_entry, sizeof(ChecksumEntry), 1, ctx->imageStream);
611 fwrite(&ctx->checksums.sha1, SHA1_DIGEST_LENGTH, 1, ctx->imageStream);
612 checksum_header.length += sizeof(ChecksumEntry) + SHA1_DIGEST_LENGTH;
613 checksum_header.entries++;
614 }
615
616 if(ctx->checksums.hasSha256)
617 {
618 TRACE("Writing SHA256 checksum entry");
619 ChecksumEntry sha256_entry = {0};
620 sha256_entry.length = SHA256_DIGEST_LENGTH;
621 sha256_entry.type = Sha256;
622 fwrite(&sha256_entry, sizeof(ChecksumEntry), 1, ctx->imageStream);
623 fwrite(&ctx->checksums.sha256, SHA256_DIGEST_LENGTH, 1, ctx->imageStream);
624 checksum_header.length += sizeof(ChecksumEntry) + SHA256_DIGEST_LENGTH;
625 checksum_header.entries++;
626 }
627
628 if(ctx->checksums.hasSpamSum)
629 {
630 TRACE("Writing SpamSum checksum entry");
631 ChecksumEntry spamsum_entry = {0};
632 spamsum_entry.length = strlen((const char *)ctx->checksums.spamsum);
633 spamsum_entry.type = SpamSum;
634 fwrite(&spamsum_entry, sizeof(ChecksumEntry), 1, ctx->imageStream);
635 fwrite(ctx->checksums.spamsum, spamsum_entry.length, 1, ctx->imageStream);
636 checksum_header.length += sizeof(ChecksumEntry) + spamsum_entry.length;
637 checksum_header.entries++;
638 }
639
640 if(ctx->checksums.hasBlake3)
641 {
642 TRACE("Writing BLAKE3 checksum entry");
643 ChecksumEntry blake3_entry = {0};
644 blake3_entry.length = BLAKE3_OUT_LEN;
645 blake3_entry.type = Blake3;
646 fwrite(&blake3_entry, sizeof(ChecksumEntry), 1, ctx->imageStream);
647 fwrite(&ctx->checksums.blake3, BLAKE3_OUT_LEN, 1, ctx->imageStream);
648 checksum_header.length += sizeof(ChecksumEntry) + BLAKE3_OUT_LEN;
649 checksum_header.entries++;
650 ctx->header.featureCompatible |= AARU_FEATURE_RW_BLAKE3;
651 }
652
653 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, checksum_position, SEEK_SET);
654 TRACE("Writing checksum header");
655 fwrite(&checksum_header, sizeof(ChecksumHeader), 1, ctx->imageStream);
656
657 // Remove any previously existing index entries of the same type before adding
658 TRACE("Removing any previously existing checksum block index entries");
659 for(int k = utarray_len(ctx->index_entries) - 1; k >= 0; k--)
660 {
661 const IndexEntry *entry = (IndexEntry *)utarray_eltptr(ctx->index_entries, k);
662 if(entry && entry->blockType == ChecksumBlock && entry->dataType == 0)
663 {
664 TRACE("Found existing checksum block index entry at position %d, removing", k);
665 utarray_erase(ctx->index_entries, k, 1);
666 }
667 }
668
669 // Add checksum block to index
670 TRACE("Adding checksum block to index");
671 IndexEntry checksum_index_entry;
672 checksum_index_entry.blockType = ChecksumBlock;
673 checksum_index_entry.dataType = 0;
674 checksum_index_entry.offset = checksum_position;
675
676 utarray_push_back(ctx->index_entries, &checksum_index_entry);
677 ctx->dirty_index_block = true;
678 TRACE("Added checksum block index entry at offset %" PRIu64, checksum_position);
679}

691static void write_tracks_block(aaruformat_context *ctx)
692{
693 // Write tracks block
694 if(ctx->tracks_header.entries <= 0 || ctx->track_entries == NULL) return;
695
696 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, 0, SEEK_END);
697 aaru_off_t tracks_position = aaruf_ftell(ctx->imageStream);
698 // Align index position to block boundary if needed
699 uint64_t alignment_mask = (1ULL << ctx->user_data_ddt_header.blockAlignmentShift) - 1;
700 if(tracks_position & alignment_mask)
701 {
702 uint64_t aligned_position = tracks_position + alignment_mask & ~alignment_mask;
703 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, aligned_position, SEEK_SET);
704 tracks_position = aligned_position;
705 }
706
707 TRACE("Writing tracks block at position %ld", tracks_position);
708 // Write header
709 if(fwrite(&ctx->tracks_header, sizeof(TracksHeader), 1, ctx->imageStream) == 1)
710 {
711 // Write entries
712 size_t written_entries =
713 fwrite(ctx->track_entries, sizeof(TrackEntry), ctx->tracks_header.entries, ctx->imageStream);
714
715 if(written_entries == ctx->tracks_header.entries)
716 {
717 TRACE("Successfully wrote tracks block with %u entries", ctx->tracks_header.entries);
718
719 // Remove any previously existing index entries of the same type before adding
720 TRACE("Removing any previously existing tracks block index entries");
721 for(int k = utarray_len(ctx->index_entries) - 1; k >= 0; k--)
722 {
723 const IndexEntry *entry = (IndexEntry *)utarray_eltptr(ctx->index_entries, k);
724 if(entry && entry->blockType == TracksBlock && entry->dataType == 0)
725 {
726 TRACE("Found existing tracks block index entry at position %d, removing", k);
727 utarray_erase(ctx->index_entries, k, 1);
728 }
729 }
730
731 // Add tracks block to index
732 TRACE("Adding tracks block to index");
733
734 IndexEntry tracks_index_entry;
735 tracks_index_entry.blockType = TracksBlock;
736 tracks_index_entry.dataType = 0;
737 tracks_index_entry.offset = tracks_position;
738 utarray_push_back(ctx->index_entries, &tracks_index_entry);
739 ctx->dirty_index_block = true;
740 TRACE("Added tracks block index entry at offset %" PRIu64, tracks_position);
741 }
742 }
743}

757static void write_mode2_subheaders_block(aaruformat_context *ctx)
758{
759 // Write MODE 2 subheader data block
760 if(ctx->mode2_subheaders == NULL) return;
761
762 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, 0, SEEK_END);
763 aaru_off_t mode2_subheaders_position = aaruf_ftell(ctx->imageStream);
764 // Align index position to block boundary if needed
765 uint64_t alignment_mask = (1ULL << ctx->user_data_ddt_header.blockAlignmentShift) - 1;
766 if(mode2_subheaders_position & alignment_mask)
767 {
768 uint64_t aligned_position = mode2_subheaders_position + alignment_mask & ~alignment_mask;
769 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, aligned_position, SEEK_SET);
770 mode2_subheaders_position = aligned_position;
771 }
772
773 TRACE("Writing MODE 2 subheaders block at position %ld", mode2_subheaders_position);
774 BlockHeader subheaders_block = {0};
775 subheaders_block.identifier = DataBlock;
776 subheaders_block.type = kDataTypeCdSubHeader;
777 subheaders_block.compression =
778 ctx->compression_enabled ? (ctx->use_zstd ? kCompressionZstd : kCompressionLzma) : kCompressionNone;
779 subheaders_block.length =
780 (uint32_t)(ctx->user_data_ddt_header.negative + ctx->image_info.Sectors + ctx->user_data_ddt_header.overflow) *
781 8;
782
783 // Calculate CRC64
784 subheaders_block.crc64 = aaruf_crc64_data(ctx->mode2_subheaders, subheaders_block.length);
785
786 uint8_t *buffer = NULL;
787 uint8_t lzma_properties[LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH] = {0};
788
789 if(subheaders_block.compression == kCompressionNone)
790 {
791 buffer = ctx->mode2_subheaders;
792 subheaders_block.cmpCrc64 = subheaders_block.crc64;
793 }
794 else
795 {
796 buffer = malloc((size_t)subheaders_block.length * 2); // Allocate double size for compression
797 if(buffer == NULL)
798 {
799 TRACE("Failed to allocate memory for MODE 2 subheaders compression");
800 return;
801 }
802
803 size_t dst_size;
804
805 if(ctx->use_zstd)
806 {
807 dst_size = aaruf_zstd_encode_buffer(buffer, (size_t)subheaders_block.length * 2, ctx->mode2_subheaders,
808 subheaders_block.length, ctx->zstd_level, ctx->num_threads);
809 if(dst_size == 0) dst_size = subheaders_block.length;
810 }
811 else
812 {
813 dst_size = (size_t)subheaders_block.length * 2 * 2;
814 size_t props_size = LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH;
815 aaruf_lzma_encode_buffer(buffer, &dst_size, ctx->mode2_subheaders, subheaders_block.length, lzma_properties,
816 &props_size, 9, ctx->lzma_dict_size, 4, 0, 2, 273, LZMA_THREADS(ctx));
817 }
818
819 subheaders_block.cmpLength = (uint32_t)dst_size;
820
821 if(subheaders_block.cmpLength >= subheaders_block.length)
822 {
823 subheaders_block.compression = kCompressionNone;
824 free(buffer);
825 buffer = ctx->mode2_subheaders;
826 }
827 }
828
829 if(subheaders_block.compression == kCompressionNone)
830 {
831 subheaders_block.cmpLength = subheaders_block.length;
832 subheaders_block.cmpCrc64 = subheaders_block.crc64;
833 }
834 else
835 {
836 subheaders_block.cmpCrc64 = aaruf_crc64_data(buffer, subheaders_block.cmpLength);
837 if(ctx->use_zstd) ctx->has_zstd_blocks = true;
838 }
839
840 const size_t length_to_write = subheaders_block.cmpLength;
841 if(subheaders_block.compression == kCompressionLzma) subheaders_block.cmpLength += LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH;
842
843 // Write header
844 if(fwrite(&subheaders_block, sizeof(BlockHeader), 1, ctx->imageStream) == 1)
845 {
846 if(subheaders_block.compression == kCompressionLzma)
847 fwrite(lzma_properties, LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH, 1, ctx->imageStream);
848
849 // Write data
850 const size_t written_bytes = fwrite(buffer, length_to_write, 1, ctx->imageStream);
851 if(written_bytes == 1)
852 {
853 TRACE("Successfully wrote MODE 2 subheaders block (%" PRIu64 " bytes)", subheaders_block.cmpLength);
854
855 // Remove any previously existing index entries of the same type before adding
856 TRACE("Removing any previously existing MODE 2 subheaders block index entries");
857 for(int k = utarray_len(ctx->index_entries) - 1; k >= 0; k--)
858 {
859 const IndexEntry *entry = (IndexEntry *)utarray_eltptr(ctx->index_entries, k);
860 if(entry && entry->blockType == DataBlock && entry->dataType == kDataTypeCdSubHeader)
861 {
862 TRACE("Found existing MODE 2 subheaders block index entry at position %d, removing", k);
863 utarray_erase(ctx->index_entries, k, 1);
864 }
865 }
866
867 // Add MODE 2 subheaders block to index
868 TRACE("Adding MODE 2 subheaders block to index");
869 IndexEntry mode2_subheaders_index_entry;
870 mode2_subheaders_index_entry.blockType = DataBlock;
871 mode2_subheaders_index_entry.dataType = kDataTypeCdSubHeader;
872 mode2_subheaders_index_entry.offset = mode2_subheaders_position;
873 utarray_push_back(ctx->index_entries, &mode2_subheaders_index_entry);
874 ctx->dirty_index_block = true;
875 TRACE("Added MODE 2 subheaders block index entry at offset %" PRIu64, mode2_subheaders_position);
876 }
877 }
878
879 if(subheaders_block.compression != kCompressionNone) free(buffer);

1423 {

1425 ddt_header2.cmpCrc64 = ddt_header2.crc64;
1426 }
1427 else
1428 {
1429 buffer = malloc((size_t)ddt_header2.length * 2); // Allocate double size for compression
1430 if(buffer == NULL)
1431 {
1432 TRACE("Failed to allocate memory for sector suffix DDT v2 compression");
1433 return;
1434 }
1435
1436 size_t dst_size;
1437
1438 if(ctx->use_zstd)
1439 {
1440 dst_size = aaruf_zstd_encode_buffer(buffer, (size_t)ddt_header2.length * 2,
1441 (uint8_t *)ctx->sector_suffix_ddt2, ddt_header2.length,
1442 ctx->zstd_level, ctx->num_threads);
1443 if(dst_size == 0) dst_size = ddt_header2.length;
1444 }
1445 else
1446 {
1447 dst_size = (size_t)ddt_header2.length * 2 * 2;
1448 size_t props_size = LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH;
1449 aaruf_lzma_encode_buffer(buffer, &dst_size, (uint8_t *)ctx->sector_suffix_ddt2, ddt_header2.length,
1450 lzma_properties, &props_size, 9, ctx->lzma_dict_size, 4, 0, 2, 273,
1451 LZMA_THREADS(ctx));
1452 }
1453
1454 ddt_header2.cmpLength = (uint32_t)dst_size;
1455
1456 if(ddt_header2.cmpLength >= ddt_header2.length)
1457 {
1458 ddt_header2.compression = kCompressionNone;
1459 free(buffer);
1460 buffer = (uint8_t *)ctx->sector_suffix_ddt2;
1461 }
1462 }
1463
1464 if(ddt_header2.compression == kCompressionNone)
1465 {
1466 ddt_header2.cmpLength = ddt_header2.length;
1467 ddt_header2.cmpCrc64 = ddt_header2.crc64;
1468 }
1469 else
1470 {
1471 ddt_header2.cmpCrc64 = aaruf_crc64_data(buffer, (uint32_t)ddt_header2.cmpLength);
1472 if(ctx->use_zstd) ctx->has_zstd_blocks = true;
1473 }
1474
1475 const size_t length_to_write = ddt_header2.cmpLength;
1476 if(ddt_header2.compression == kCompressionLzma) ddt_header2.cmpLength += LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH;
1477
1478 // Write header
1479 if(fwrite(&ddt_header2, sizeof(DdtHeader2), 1, ctx->imageStream) == 1)
1480 {
1481 if(ddt_header2.compression == kCompressionLzma)
1482 fwrite(lzma_properties, LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH, 1, ctx->imageStream);
1483
1484 // Write data
1485 const size_t written_bytes = fwrite(buffer, length_to_write, 1, ctx->imageStream);
1486 if(written_bytes == 1)
1487 {
1488 TRACE("Successfully wrote sector suffix DDT v2 (%" PRIu64 " bytes)", ddt_header2.cmpLength);
1489
1490 // Remove any previously existing index entries of the same type before adding
1491 TRACE("Removing any previously existing sector suffix DDT v2 block index entries");
1492 for(int k = utarray_len(ctx->index_entries) - 1; k >= 0; k--)
1493 {
1494 const IndexEntry *entry = (IndexEntry *)utarray_eltptr(ctx->index_entries, k);
1495 if(entry && entry->blockType == DeDuplicationTable2 && entry->dataType == kDataTypeCdSectorSuffix)
1496 {
1497 TRACE("Found existing sector suffix DDT v2 index entry at position %d, removing", k);
1498 utarray_erase(ctx->index_entries, k, 1);
1499 }
1500 }
1501
1502 // Add suffix block to index
1503 TRACE("Adding sector suffix DDT v2 to index");
1504 IndexEntry suffix_ddt_index_entry;
1505 suffix_ddt_index_entry.blockType = DeDuplicationTable2;
1506 suffix_ddt_index_entry.dataType = kDataTypeCdSectorSuffix;
1507 suffix_ddt_index_entry.offset = suffix_ddt_position;
1508 utarray_push_back(ctx->index_entries, &suffix_ddt_index_entry);
1509 ctx->dirty_index_block = true;
1510 TRACE("Added sector suffix DDT v2 index entry at offset %" PRIu64, suffix_ddt_position);
1511 }
1512 }
1513
1514 if(ddt_header2.compression != kCompressionNone) free(buffer);
1515}
1516
1574static void write_sector_subchannel(aaruformat_context *ctx)
1575{
1576 if(ctx->sector_subchannel == NULL) return;
1577
1578 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, 0, SEEK_END);
1579 aaru_off_t block_position = aaruf_ftell(ctx->imageStream);
1580 // Align index position to block boundary if needed
1581 const uint64_t alignment_mask = (1ULL << ctx->user_data_ddt_header.blockAlignmentShift) - 1;
1582 if(block_position & alignment_mask)
1583 {
1584 const uint64_t aligned_position = block_position + alignment_mask & ~alignment_mask;
1585 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, aligned_position, SEEK_SET);
1586 block_position = aligned_position;
1587 }
1588
1589 TRACE("Writing sector subchannel block at position %ld", block_position);
1590 BlockHeader subchannel_block = {0};
1591 subchannel_block.identifier = DataBlock;
1592 subchannel_block.compression = kCompressionNone;
1593
1594 uint8_t *buffer = ctx->sector_subchannel;
1595 bool owns_buffer = false;
1596 uint8_t lzma_properties[LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH] = {0};
1597
1598 if(ctx->image_info.MetadataMediaType == OpticalDisc)
1599 {
1600 subchannel_block.type = kDataTypeCdSubchannel;
1601 subchannel_block.length = (uint32_t)(ctx->user_data_ddt_header.negative + ctx->image_info.Sectors +
1602 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.overflow) *
1603 96;
1604 subchannel_block.cmpLength = subchannel_block.length;
1605
1606 if(ctx->compression_enabled)
1607 {
1608 uint8_t *cst_buffer = malloc(subchannel_block.length);
1609
1610 if(cst_buffer == NULL)
1611 {
1612 TRACE("Failed to allocate memory for Claunia Subchannel Transform output");
1613 return;
1614 }
1615
1616 uint8_t *dst_buffer = malloc(subchannel_block.length);
1617
1618 if(dst_buffer == NULL)
1619 {
1620 TRACE("Failed to allocate memory for compressed output");
1621 free(cst_buffer);
1622 return;
1623 }
1624
1625 aaruf_cst_transform(ctx->sector_subchannel, cst_buffer, subchannel_block.length);
1626
1627 size_t dst_size;
1628
1629 if(ctx->use_zstd)
1630 {
1631 dst_size = aaruf_zstd_encode_buffer(dst_buffer, subchannel_block.length, cst_buffer,
1632 subchannel_block.length, ctx->zstd_level, ctx->num_threads);
1633 if(dst_size == 0) dst_size = subchannel_block.length; /* compression failed, fall through to none */
1634 }
1635 else
1636 {
1637 dst_size = subchannel_block.length;
1638 size_t props_size = LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH;
1639
1640 aaruf_lzma_encode_buffer(dst_buffer, &dst_size, cst_buffer, subchannel_block.length, lzma_properties,
1641 &props_size, 9, ctx->lzma_dict_size, 4, 0, 2, 273, LZMA_THREADS(ctx));
1642 }
1643
1644 free(cst_buffer);
1645
1646 if(dst_size < subchannel_block.length)
1647 {
1648 subchannel_block.compression = ctx->use_zstd ? kCompressionZstdCst : kCompressionLzmaCst;
1649 subchannel_block.cmpLength = (uint32_t)dst_size;
1650 buffer = dst_buffer;
1651 owns_buffer = true;
1652 }
1653 else
1654 {
1655 subchannel_block.compression = kCompressionNone;
1656 free(dst_buffer);
1657 subchannel_block.cmpLength = subchannel_block.length;
1658 }
1659 }
1660 }
1661 else if(ctx->image_info.MetadataMediaType == BlockMedia)
1662 {
1663 switch(ctx->image_info.MediaType)
1664 {
1665 case AppleProfile:
1666 case AppleFileWare:
1667 subchannel_block.type = kDataTypeAppleProfileTag;
1668 subchannel_block.length = (uint32_t)(ctx->image_info.Sectors + ctx->user_data_ddt_header.overflow) * 20;
1669 break;
1670 case AppleSonyDS:
1671 case AppleSonySS:
1672 subchannel_block.type = kDataTypeAppleSonyTag;
1673 subchannel_block.length = (uint32_t)(ctx->image_info.Sectors + ctx->user_data_ddt_header.overflow) * 12;
1674 break;
1675 case PriamDataTower:
1676 subchannel_block.type = kDataTypePriamDataTowerTag;
1677 subchannel_block.length = (uint32_t)(ctx->image_info.Sectors + ctx->user_data_ddt_header.overflow) * 24;
1678 break;
1679 default:
1680 TRACE("Incorrect media type, not writing sector subchannel block");
1681 return; // Incorrect media type
1682 }
1683 subchannel_block.cmpLength = subchannel_block.length;
1684
1685 uint8_t *dst_buffer = malloc(subchannel_block.length);
1686
1687 if(dst_buffer == NULL)
1688 {
1689 TRACE("Failed to allocate memory for compressed output");
1690 return;
1691 }
1692
1693 size_t dst_size;
1694
1695 if(ctx->use_zstd)
1696 {
1697 dst_size = aaruf_zstd_encode_buffer(dst_buffer, subchannel_block.length, ctx->sector_subchannel,
1698 subchannel_block.length, ctx->zstd_level, ctx->num_threads);
1699 if(dst_size == 0) dst_size = subchannel_block.length; /* compression failed, fall through to none */
1700 }
1701 else
1702 {
1703 dst_size = subchannel_block.length;
1704 size_t props_size = LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH;
1705
1706 aaruf_lzma_encode_buffer(dst_buffer, &dst_size, ctx->sector_subchannel, subchannel_block.length,
1707 lzma_properties, &props_size, 9, ctx->lzma_dict_size, 4, 0, 2, 273, LZMA_THREADS(ctx));
1708 }
1709
1710 if(dst_size < subchannel_block.length)
1711 {
1712 subchannel_block.compression = ctx->use_zstd ? kCompressionZstd : kCompressionLzma;
1713 subchannel_block.cmpLength = (uint32_t)dst_size;
1714 buffer = dst_buffer;
1715 owns_buffer = true;
1716 }
1717 else
1718 {
1719 subchannel_block.compression = kCompressionNone;
1720 free(dst_buffer);
1721 subchannel_block.cmpLength = subchannel_block.length;
1722 }
1723 }
1724 else
1725 {
1726 TRACE("Incorrect media type, not writing sector subchannel block");
1727 return; // Incorrect media type
1728 }
1729
1730 // Calculate CRC64 for raw subchannel data and compressed payload when present
1731 subchannel_block.crc64 = aaruf_crc64_data(ctx->sector_subchannel, subchannel_block.length);
1732 if(subchannel_block.compression == kCompressionNone)
1733 subchannel_block.cmpCrc64 = subchannel_block.crc64;
1734 else
1735 {
1736 subchannel_block.cmpCrc64 = aaruf_crc64_data(buffer, subchannel_block.cmpLength);
1737 if(ctx->use_zstd) ctx->has_zstd_blocks = true;
1738 }
1739
1740 const size_t length_to_write = subchannel_block.cmpLength;
1741 const bool has_lzma_props = subchannel_block.compression == kCompressionLzma ||
1742 subchannel_block.compression == kCompressionLzmaCst;
1743 if(has_lzma_props) subchannel_block.cmpLength += LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH;
1744
1745 // Write header
1746 if(fwrite(&subchannel_block, sizeof(BlockHeader), 1, ctx->imageStream) == 1)
1747 {
1748 if(has_lzma_props)
1749 fwrite(lzma_properties, LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH, 1, ctx->imageStream);
1750
1751 // Write data
1752 const size_t written_bytes = fwrite(buffer, length_to_write, 1, ctx->imageStream);
1753 if(written_bytes == 1)
1754 {
1755 TRACE("Successfully wrote sector subchannel block (%" PRIu64 " bytes)", subchannel_block.cmpLength);
1756
1757 // Remove any previously existing index entries of the same type before adding
1758 TRACE("Removing any previously existing subchannel block index entries");
1759 for(int k = utarray_len(ctx->index_entries) - 1; k >= 0; k--)
1760 {
1761 const IndexEntry *entry = (IndexEntry *)utarray_eltptr(ctx->index_entries, k);
1762 if(entry && entry->blockType == DataBlock && entry->dataType == subchannel_block.type)
1763 {
1764 TRACE("Found existing subchannel block index entry at position %d, removing", k);
1765 utarray_erase(ctx->index_entries, k, 1);
1766 }
1767 }
1768
1769 // Add subchannel block to index
1770 TRACE("Adding sector subchannel block to index");
1771 IndexEntry subchannel_index_entry;
1772 subchannel_index_entry.blockType = DataBlock;
1773 subchannel_index_entry.dataType = subchannel_block.type;
1774 subchannel_index_entry.offset = block_position;
1775 utarray_push_back(ctx->index_entries, &subchannel_index_entry);
1776 ctx->dirty_index_block = true;
1777 TRACE("Added sector subchannel block index entry at offset %" PRIu64, block_position);
1778 }
1779 }
1780
1781 if(owns_buffer) free(buffer);
1782}
1783
1785static bool is_bluray_media(const uint32_t media_type)
1786{
1787 switch(media_type)
1788 {
1789 case BDROM:
1790 case BDR:
1791 case BDRE:
1792 case BDRXL:
1793 case BDREXL:
1794 case UHDBD:
1795 case XGD4:
1796 case PS3BD:
1797 case PS4BD:
1798 case PS5BD:
1799 return true;
1800 default:
1801 return false;
1802 }
1803}

1941static void write_dvd_long_sector_blocks(aaruformat_context *ctx)
1942{
1943 // Blu-ray images keep their EDC in sector_edc too, written by write_bd_sector_edc_block()
1944 if(is_bluray_media(ctx->image_info.MediaType)) return;
1945
1946 if(ctx->sector_id == NULL && ctx->sector_ied == NULL && ctx->sector_cpr_mai == NULL && ctx->sector_edc == NULL)
1947 return;
1948
1949 uint64_t total_sectors =
1950 ctx->user_data_ddt_header.negative + ctx->image_info.Sectors + ctx->user_data_ddt_header.overflow;
1951
1952 const uint64_t alignment_mask = (1ULL << ctx->user_data_ddt_header.blockAlignmentShift) - 1;
1953 uint8_t *buffer = NULL;
1954 uint8_t lzma_properties[LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH] = {0};
1955 size_t length_to_write = 0;
1956
1957 if(ctx->sector_id != NULL)
1958 {
1959 // Write DVD sector ID block
1960 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, 0, SEEK_END);
1961 aaru_off_t id_position = aaruf_ftell(ctx->imageStream);
1962 if(id_position & alignment_mask)
1963 {
1964 const uint64_t aligned_position = id_position + alignment_mask & ~alignment_mask;
1965 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, aligned_position, SEEK_SET);
1966 id_position = aligned_position;
1967 }
1968 TRACE("Writing DVD sector ID block at position %ld", id_position);
1969 BlockHeader id_block = {0};
1970 id_block.identifier = DataBlock;
1971 id_block.type = kDataTypeDvdSectorId;
1972 id_block.compression =
1973 ctx->compression_enabled ? (ctx->use_zstd ? kCompressionZstd : kCompressionLzma) : kCompressionNone;
1974 id_block.length = (uint32_t)total_sectors * 4;
1975
1976 // Calculate CRC64
1977 id_block.crc64 = aaruf_crc64_data(ctx->sector_id, id_block.length);
1978
1979 buffer = NULL;
1980
1981 if(id_block.compression == kCompressionNone)
1982 {
1983 buffer = ctx->sector_id;
1984 id_block.cmpCrc64 = id_block.crc64;
1985 }
1986 else
1987 {
1988 buffer = malloc((size_t)id_block.length * 2); // Allocate double size for compression
1989 if(buffer == NULL)
1990 {
1991 TRACE("Failed to allocate memory for DVD sector ID compression");
1992 return;
1993 }
1994
1995 size_t dst_size;
1996
1997 if(ctx->use_zstd)
1998 {
1999 dst_size = aaruf_zstd_encode_buffer(buffer, (size_t)id_block.length * 2, ctx->sector_id,
2000 id_block.length, ctx->zstd_level, ctx->num_threads);
2001 if(dst_size == 0) dst_size = id_block.length;
2002 }
2003 else
2004 {
2005 dst_size = (size_t)id_block.length * 2 * 2;
2006 size_t props_size = LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH;
2007 aaruf_lzma_encode_buffer(buffer, &dst_size, ctx->sector_id, id_block.length, lzma_properties,
2008 &props_size, 9, ctx->lzma_dict_size, 4, 0, 2, 273, LZMA_THREADS(ctx));
2009 }
2010
2011 id_block.cmpLength = (uint32_t)dst_size;
2012
2013 if(id_block.cmpLength >= id_block.length)
2014 {
2015 id_block.compression = kCompressionNone;
2016 free(buffer);
2017 buffer = ctx->sector_id;
2018 }
2019 }
2020
2021 if(id_block.compression == kCompressionNone)
2022 {
2023 id_block.cmpLength = id_block.length;
2024 id_block.cmpCrc64 = id_block.crc64;
2025 }
2026 else
2027 {
2028 id_block.cmpCrc64 = aaruf_crc64_data(buffer, id_block.cmpLength);
2029 if(ctx->use_zstd) ctx->has_zstd_blocks = true;
2030 }
2031
2032 length_to_write = id_block.cmpLength;
2033 if(id_block.compression == kCompressionLzma) id_block.cmpLength += LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH;
2034
2035 // Write header
2036 if(fwrite(&id_block, sizeof(BlockHeader), 1, ctx->imageStream) == 1)
2037 {
2038 if(id_block.compression == kCompressionLzma)
2039 fwrite(lzma_properties, LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH, 1, ctx->imageStream);
2040
2041 // Write data
2042 const size_t written_bytes = fwrite(buffer, length_to_write, 1, ctx->imageStream);
2043 if(written_bytes == 1)
2044 {
2045 TRACE("Successfully wrote DVD sector ID block (%" PRIu64 " bytes)", id_block.cmpLength);
2046
2047 // Remove any previously existing index entries of the same type before adding
2048 TRACE("Removing any previously existing DVD sector ID block index entries");
2049 for(int k = utarray_len(ctx->index_entries) - 1; k >= 0; k--)
2050 {
2051 const IndexEntry *entry = (IndexEntry *)utarray_eltptr(ctx->index_entries, k);
2052 if(entry && entry->blockType == DataBlock && entry->dataType == kDataTypeDvdSectorId)
2053 {
2054 TRACE("Found existing DVD sector ID block index entry at position %d, removing", k);
2055 utarray_erase(ctx->index_entries, k, 1);
2056 }
2057 }
2058
2059 // Add ID block to index
2060 TRACE("Adding DVD sector ID block to index");
2061 IndexEntry id_index_entry;
2062 id_index_entry.blockType = DataBlock;
2063 id_index_entry.dataType = kDataTypeDvdSectorId;
2064 id_index_entry.offset = id_position;
2065 utarray_push_back(ctx->index_entries, &id_index_entry);
2066 ctx->dirty_index_block = true;
2067 TRACE("Added DVD sector ID block index entry at offset %" PRIu64, id_position);
2068 }
2069 }
2070
2071 if(id_block.compression != kCompressionNone) free(buffer);
2072 }
2073
2074 if(ctx->sector_ied != NULL)
2075 {
2076 // Write DVD sector IED block
2077 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, 0, SEEK_END);
2078 aaru_off_t ied_position = aaruf_ftell(ctx->imageStream);
2079 if(ied_position & alignment_mask)
2080 {
2081 const uint64_t aligned_position = ied_position + alignment_mask & ~alignment_mask;
2082 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, aligned_position, SEEK_SET);
2083 ied_position = aligned_position;
2084 }
2085 TRACE("Writing DVD sector IED block at position %ld", ied_position);
2086 BlockHeader ied_block = {0};
2087 ied_block.identifier = DataBlock;
2088 ied_block.type = kDataTypeDvdSectorIed;
2089 ied_block.compression =
2090 ctx->compression_enabled ? (ctx->use_zstd ? kCompressionZstd : kCompressionLzma) : kCompressionNone;
2091 ied_block.length = (uint32_t)total_sectors * 2;
2092 // Calculate CRC64
2093 ied_block.crc64 = aaruf_crc64_data(ctx->sector_ied, ied_block.length);
2094
2095 buffer = NULL;
2096
2097 if(ied_block.compression == kCompressionNone)
2098 {
2099 buffer = ctx->sector_ied;
2100 ied_block.cmpCrc64 = ied_block.crc64;
2101 }
2102 else
2103 {
2104 buffer = malloc((size_t)ied_block.length * 2); // Allocate double size for compression
2105 if(buffer == NULL)
2106 {
2107 TRACE("Failed to allocate memory for DVD sector IED compression");
2108 return;
2109 }
2110
2111 size_t dst_size;
2112
2113 if(ctx->use_zstd)
2114 {
2115 dst_size = aaruf_zstd_encode_buffer(buffer, (size_t)ied_block.length * 2, ctx->sector_ied,
2116 ied_block.length, ctx->zstd_level, ctx->num_threads);
2117 if(dst_size == 0) dst_size = ied_block.length;
2118 }
2119 else
2120 {
2121 dst_size = (size_t)ied_block.length * 2 * 2;
2122 size_t props_size = LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH;
2123 aaruf_lzma_encode_buffer(buffer, &dst_size, ctx->sector_ied, ied_block.length, lzma_properties,
2124 &props_size, 9, ctx->lzma_dict_size, 4, 0, 2, 273, LZMA_THREADS(ctx));
2125 }
2126
2127 ied_block.cmpLength = (uint32_t)dst_size;
2128
2129 if(ied_block.cmpLength >= ied_block.length)
2130 {
2131 ied_block.compression = kCompressionNone;
2132 free(buffer);
2133 buffer = ctx->sector_ied;
2134 }
2135 }
2136
2137 if(ied_block.compression == kCompressionNone)
2138 {
2139 ied_block.cmpLength = ied_block.length;
2140 ied_block.cmpCrc64 = ied_block.crc64;
2141 }
2142 else
2143 {
2144 ied_block.cmpCrc64 = aaruf_crc64_data(buffer, ied_block.cmpLength);
2145 if(ctx->use_zstd) ctx->has_zstd_blocks = true;
2146 }
2147
2148 length_to_write = ied_block.cmpLength;
2149 if(ied_block.compression == kCompressionLzma) ied_block.cmpLength += LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH;
2150
2151 // Write header
2152 if(fwrite(&ied_block, sizeof(BlockHeader), 1, ctx->imageStream) == 1)
2153 {
2154 if(ied_block.compression == kCompressionLzma)
2155 fwrite(lzma_properties, LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH, 1, ctx->imageStream);
2156
2157 // Write data
2158 const size_t written_bytes = fwrite(buffer, length_to_write, 1, ctx->imageStream);
2159 if(written_bytes == 1)
2160 {
2161 TRACE("Successfully wrote DVD sector IED block (%" PRIu64 " bytes)", ied_block.cmpLength);
2162
2163 // Remove any previously existing index entries of the same type before adding
2164 TRACE("Removing any previously existing DVD sector IED block index entries");
2165 for(int k = utarray_len(ctx->index_entries) - 1; k >= 0; k--)
2166 {
2167 const IndexEntry *entry = (IndexEntry *)utarray_eltptr(ctx->index_entries, k);
2168 if(entry && entry->blockType == DataBlock && entry->dataType == kDataTypeDvdSectorIed)
2169 {
2170 TRACE("Found existing DVD sector IED block index entry at position %d, removing", k);
2171 utarray_erase(ctx->index_entries, k, 1);
2172 }
2173 }
2174
2175 // Add IED block to index
2176 TRACE("Adding DVD sector IED block to index");
2177 IndexEntry ied_index_entry;
2178 ied_index_entry.blockType = DataBlock;
2179 ied_index_entry.dataType = kDataTypeDvdSectorIed;
2180 ied_index_entry.offset = ied_position;
2181 utarray_push_back(ctx->index_entries, &ied_index_entry);
2182 ctx->dirty_index_block = true;
2183 TRACE("Added DVD sector IED block index entry at offset %" PRIu64, ied_position);
2184 }
2185 }
2186
2187 if(ied_block.compression != kCompressionNone) free(buffer);
2188 }
2189
2190 if(ctx->sector_cpr_mai != NULL)
2191 {
2192 // Write DVD sector CPR/MAI block
2193 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, 0, SEEK_END);
2194 aaru_off_t cpr_mai_position = aaruf_ftell(ctx->imageStream);
2195 if(cpr_mai_position & alignment_mask)
2196 {
2197 const uint64_t aligned_position = cpr_mai_position + alignment_mask & ~alignment_mask;
2198 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, aligned_position, SEEK_SET);
2199 cpr_mai_position = aligned_position;
2200 }
2201 TRACE("Writing DVD sector CPR/MAI block at position %ld", cpr_mai_position);
2202 BlockHeader cpr_mai_block = {0};
2203 cpr_mai_block.identifier = DataBlock;
2204 cpr_mai_block.type = kDataTypeDvdSectorCprMai;
2205 cpr_mai_block.compression =
2206 ctx->compression_enabled ? (ctx->use_zstd ? kCompressionZstd : kCompressionLzma) : kCompressionNone;
2207 cpr_mai_block.length = (uint32_t)total_sectors * 6;
2208 // Calculate CRC64
2209 cpr_mai_block.crc64 = aaruf_crc64_data(ctx->sector_cpr_mai, cpr_mai_block.length);
2210
2211 buffer = NULL;
2212
2213 if(cpr_mai_block.compression == kCompressionNone)
2214 {
2215 buffer = ctx->sector_cpr_mai;
2216 cpr_mai_block.cmpCrc64 = cpr_mai_block.crc64;
2217 }
2218 else
2219 {
2220 buffer = malloc((size_t)cpr_mai_block.length * 2); // Allocate double size for compression
2221 if(buffer == NULL)
2222 {
2223 TRACE("Failed to allocate memory for DVD sector CPR/MAI compression");
2224 return;
2225 }
2226
2227 size_t dst_size;
2228
2229 if(ctx->use_zstd)
2230 {
2231 dst_size = aaruf_zstd_encode_buffer(buffer, (size_t)cpr_mai_block.length * 2, ctx->sector_cpr_mai,
2232 cpr_mai_block.length, ctx->zstd_level, ctx->num_threads);
2233 if(dst_size == 0) dst_size = cpr_mai_block.length;
2234 }
2235 else
2236 {
2237 dst_size = (size_t)cpr_mai_block.length * 2 * 2;
2238 size_t props_size = LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH;
2239 aaruf_lzma_encode_buffer(buffer, &dst_size, ctx->sector_cpr_mai, cpr_mai_block.length, lzma_properties,
2240 &props_size, 9, ctx->lzma_dict_size, 4, 0, 2, 273, LZMA_THREADS(ctx));
2241 }
2242
2243 cpr_mai_block.cmpLength = (uint32_t)dst_size;
2244
2245 if(cpr_mai_block.cmpLength >= cpr_mai_block.length)
2246 {
2247 cpr_mai_block.compression = kCompressionNone;
2248 free(buffer);
2249 buffer = ctx->sector_cpr_mai;
2250 }
2251 }
2252
2253 if(cpr_mai_block.compression == kCompressionNone)
2254 {
2255 cpr_mai_block.cmpLength = cpr_mai_block.length;
2256 cpr_mai_block.cmpCrc64 = cpr_mai_block.crc64;
2257 }
2258 else
2259 {
2260 cpr_mai_block.cmpCrc64 = aaruf_crc64_data(buffer, cpr_mai_block.cmpLength);
2261 if(ctx->use_zstd) ctx->has_zstd_blocks = true;
2262 }
2263
2264 length_to_write = cpr_mai_block.cmpLength;
2265 if(cpr_mai_block.compression == kCompressionLzma) cpr_mai_block.cmpLength += LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH;
2266
2267 // Write header
2268 if(fwrite(&cpr_mai_block, sizeof(BlockHeader), 1, ctx->imageStream) == 1)
2269 {
2270 if(cpr_mai_block.compression == kCompressionLzma)
2271 fwrite(lzma_properties, LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH, 1, ctx->imageStream);
2272
2273 // Write data
2274 const size_t written_bytes = fwrite(buffer, length_to_write, 1, ctx->imageStream);
2275 if(written_bytes == 1)
2276 {
2277 TRACE("Successfully wrote DVD sector CPR/MAI block (%" PRIu64 " bytes)", cpr_mai_block.cmpLength);
2278
2279 // Remove any previously existing index entries of the same type before adding
2280 TRACE("Removing any previously existing DVD sector CPR/MAI block index entries");
2281 for(int k = utarray_len(ctx->index_entries) - 1; k >= 0; k--)
2282 {
2283 const IndexEntry *entry = (IndexEntry *)utarray_eltptr(ctx->index_entries, k);
2284 if(entry && entry->blockType == DataBlock && entry->dataType == kDataTypeDvdSectorCprMai)
2285 {
2286 TRACE("Found existing DVD sector CPR/MAI block index entry at position %d, removing", k);
2287 utarray_erase(ctx->index_entries, k, 1);
2288 }
2289 }
2290
2291 // Add CPR/MAI block to index
2292 TRACE("Adding DVD sector CPR/MAI block to index");
2293 IndexEntry cpr_mai_index_entry;
2294 cpr_mai_index_entry.blockType = DataBlock;
2295 cpr_mai_index_entry.dataType = kDataTypeDvdSectorCprMai;
2296 cpr_mai_index_entry.offset = cpr_mai_position;
2297 utarray_push_back(ctx->index_entries, &cpr_mai_index_entry);
2298 ctx->dirty_index_block = true;
2299 TRACE("Added DVD sector CPR/MAI block index entry at offset %" PRIu64, cpr_mai_position);
2300 }
2301 }
2302
2303 if(cpr_mai_block.compression != kCompressionNone) free(buffer);
2304 }
2305
2306 if(ctx->sector_edc != NULL)
2307 {
2308 // Write DVD sector EDC block
2309 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, 0, SEEK_END);
2310 aaru_off_t edc_position = aaruf_ftell(ctx->imageStream);
2311 if(edc_position & alignment_mask)
2312 {
2313 const uint64_t aligned_position = edc_position + alignment_mask & ~alignment_mask;
2314 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, aligned_position, SEEK_SET);
2315 edc_position = aligned_position;
2316 }
2317 TRACE("Writing DVD sector EDC block at position %ld", edc_position);
2318 BlockHeader edc_block = {0};
2319 edc_block.identifier = DataBlock;
2320 edc_block.type = kDataTypeDvdSectorEdc;
2321 edc_block.compression =
2322 ctx->compression_enabled ? (ctx->use_zstd ? kCompressionZstd : kCompressionLzma) : kCompressionNone;
2323 edc_block.length = (uint32_t)total_sectors * 4;
2324 // Calculate CRC64
2325 edc_block.crc64 = aaruf_crc64_data(ctx->sector_edc, edc_block.length);
2326
2327 buffer = NULL;
2328
2329 if(edc_block.compression == kCompressionNone)
2330 {
2331 buffer = ctx->sector_edc;
2332 edc_block.cmpCrc64 = edc_block.crc64;
2333 }
2334 else
2335 {
2336 buffer = malloc((size_t)edc_block.length * 2); // Allocate double size for compression
2337 if(buffer == NULL)
2338 {
2339 TRACE("Failed to allocate memory for DVD sector EDC compression");
2340 return;
2341 }
2342
2343 size_t dst_size;
2344
2345 if(ctx->use_zstd)
2346 {
2347 dst_size = aaruf_zstd_encode_buffer(buffer, (size_t)edc_block.length * 2, ctx->sector_edc,
2348 edc_block.length, ctx->zstd_level, ctx->num_threads);
2349 if(dst_size == 0) dst_size = edc_block.length;
2350 }
2351 else
2352 {
2353 dst_size = (size_t)edc_block.length * 2 * 2;
2354 size_t props_size = LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH;
2355 aaruf_lzma_encode_buffer(buffer, &dst_size, ctx->sector_edc, edc_block.length, lzma_properties,
2356 &props_size, 9, ctx->lzma_dict_size, 4, 0, 2, 273, LZMA_THREADS(ctx));
2357 }
2358
2359 edc_block.cmpLength = (uint32_t)dst_size;
2360
2361 if(edc_block.cmpLength >= edc_block.length)
2362 {
2363 edc_block.compression = kCompressionNone;
2364 free(buffer);
2365 buffer = ctx->sector_edc;
2366 }
2367 }
2368
2369 if(edc_block.compression == kCompressionNone)
2370 {
2371 edc_block.cmpLength = edc_block.length;
2372 edc_block.cmpCrc64 = edc_block.crc64;
2373 }
2374 else
2375 {
2376 edc_block.cmpCrc64 = aaruf_crc64_data(buffer, edc_block.cmpLength);
2377 if(ctx->use_zstd) ctx->has_zstd_blocks = true;
2378 }
2379
2380 length_to_write = edc_block.cmpLength;
2381 if(edc_block.compression == kCompressionLzma) edc_block.cmpLength += LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH;
2382
2383 // Write header
2384 if(fwrite(&edc_block, sizeof(BlockHeader), 1, ctx->imageStream) == 1)
2385 {
2386 if(edc_block.compression == kCompressionLzma)
2387 fwrite(lzma_properties, LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH, 1, ctx->imageStream);
2388
2389 // Write data
2390 const size_t written_bytes = fwrite(buffer, length_to_write, 1, ctx->imageStream);
2391 if(written_bytes == 1)
2392 {
2393 TRACE("Successfully wrote DVD sector EDC block (%" PRIu64 " bytes)", edc_block.cmpLength);
2394
2395 // Remove any previously existing index entries of the same type before adding
2396 TRACE("Removing any previously existing DVD sector EDC block index entries");
2397 for(int k = utarray_len(ctx->index_entries) - 1; k >= 0; k--)
2398 {
2399 const IndexEntry *entry = (IndexEntry *)utarray_eltptr(ctx->index_entries, k);
2400 if(entry && entry->blockType == DataBlock && entry->dataType == kDataTypeDvdSectorEdc)
2401 {
2402 TRACE("Found existing DVD sector EDC block index entry at position %d, removing", k);
2403 utarray_erase(ctx->index_entries, k, 1);
2404 }
2405 }
2406
2407 // Add EDC block to index
2408 TRACE("Adding DVD sector EDC block to index");
2409 IndexEntry edc_index_entry;
2410 edc_index_entry.blockType = DataBlock;
2411 edc_index_entry.dataType = kDataTypeDvdSectorEdc;
2412 edc_index_entry.offset = edc_position;
2413 utarray_push_back(ctx->index_entries, &edc_index_entry);
2414 ctx->dirty_index_block = true;
2415 TRACE("Added DVD sector EDC block index entry at offset %" PRIu64, edc_position);
2416 }
2417 }
2418
2419 if(edc_block.compression != kCompressionNone) free(buffer);
2420 }
2421}

2588 }

2593 edc_block.cmpLength = edc_block.length;
2594 edc_block.cmpCrc64 = edc_block.crc64;
2595 }
2596 else
2597 {
2598 edc_block.cmpCrc64 = aaruf_crc64_data(buffer, edc_block.cmpLength);

2932static void write_media_tags(aaruformat_context *ctx)
2933{
2934 if(ctx->mediaTags == NULL) return;
2935
2936 mediaTagEntry *media_tag = NULL;
2937 mediaTagEntry *tmp_media_tag = NULL;
2938
2939 HASH_ITER(hh, ctx->mediaTags, media_tag, tmp_media_tag)
2940 {
2941 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, 0, SEEK_END);
2942 aaru_off_t tag_position = aaruf_ftell(ctx->imageStream);
2943 const uint64_t alignment_mask = (1ULL << ctx->user_data_ddt_header.blockAlignmentShift) - 1;
2944 if(tag_position & alignment_mask)
2945 {
2946 const uint64_t aligned_position = tag_position + alignment_mask & ~alignment_mask;
2947 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, aligned_position, SEEK_SET);
2948 tag_position = aligned_position;
2949 }
2950
2951 TRACE("Writing media tag block type %d at position %ld", aaruf_get_datatype_for_media_tag_type(media_tag->type),
2952 tag_position);
2953 BlockHeader tag_block = {0};
2954 tag_block.identifier = DataBlock;
2955 tag_block.type = (uint16_t)aaruf_get_datatype_for_media_tag_type(media_tag->type);
2956 tag_block.compression =
2957 ctx->compression_enabled ? (ctx->use_zstd ? kCompressionZstd : kCompressionLzma) : kCompressionNone;
2958 tag_block.length = media_tag->length;
2959
2960 // Calculate CRC64
2961 tag_block.crc64 = aaruf_crc64_data(media_tag->data, tag_block.length);
2962
2963 uint8_t *buffer = NULL;
2964 uint8_t lzma_properties[LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH] = {0};
2965
2966 if(tag_block.compression == kCompressionNone)
2967 {
2968 buffer = media_tag->data;
2969 tag_block.cmpCrc64 = tag_block.crc64;
2970 }
2971 else
2972 {
2973 buffer = malloc((size_t)tag_block.length * 2); // Allocate double size for compression
2974 if(buffer == NULL)
2975 {
2976 TRACE("Failed to allocate memory for media tag compression");
2977 return;
2978 }
2979
2980 size_t dst_size;
2981
2982 if(ctx->use_zstd)
2983 {
2984 dst_size = aaruf_zstd_encode_buffer(buffer, (size_t)tag_block.length * 2, media_tag->data,
2985 tag_block.length, ctx->zstd_level, ctx->num_threads);
2986 if(dst_size == 0) dst_size = tag_block.length;
2987 }
2988 else
2989 {
2990 dst_size = (size_t)tag_block.length * 2 * 2;
2991 size_t props_size = LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH;
2992 aaruf_lzma_encode_buffer(buffer, &dst_size, media_tag->data, tag_block.length, lzma_properties,
2993 &props_size, 9, ctx->lzma_dict_size, 4, 0, 2, 273, LZMA_THREADS(ctx));
2994 }
2995
2996 tag_block.cmpLength = (uint32_t)dst_size;
2997
2998 if(tag_block.cmpLength >= tag_block.length)
2999 {
3000 tag_block.compression = kCompressionNone;
3001 free(buffer);
3002 buffer = media_tag->data;
3003 }
3004 }
3005
3006 if(tag_block.compression == kCompressionNone)
3007 {
3008 tag_block.cmpLength = tag_block.length;
3009 tag_block.cmpCrc64 = tag_block.crc64;
3010 }
3011 else
3012 {
3013 tag_block.cmpCrc64 = aaruf_crc64_data(buffer, tag_block.cmpLength);
3014 if(ctx->use_zstd) ctx->has_zstd_blocks = true;
3015 }
3016
3017 const size_t length_to_write = tag_block.cmpLength;
3018 if(tag_block.compression == kCompressionLzma) tag_block.cmpLength += LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH;
3019
3020 // Write header
3021 if(fwrite(&tag_block, sizeof(BlockHeader), 1, ctx->imageStream) == 1)
3022 {
3023 if(tag_block.compression == kCompressionLzma)
3024 fwrite(lzma_properties, LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH, 1, ctx->imageStream); // Write data
3025
3026 const size_t written_bytes = fwrite(buffer, length_to_write, 1, ctx->imageStream);
3027 if(written_bytes == 1)
3028 {
3029 TRACE("Successfully wrote media tag block type %d (%" PRIu64 " bytes)", tag_block.type,
3030 tag_block.cmpLength);
3031
3032 // Remove any previously existing index entries of the same type before adding
3033 TRACE("Removing any previously existing media tag type %d block index entries", tag_block.type);
3034 for(int k = utarray_len(ctx->index_entries) - 1; k >= 0; k--)
3035 {
3036 const IndexEntry *entry = (IndexEntry *)utarray_eltptr(ctx->index_entries, k);
3037 if(entry && entry->blockType == DataBlock && entry->dataType == tag_block.type)
3038 {
3039 TRACE("Found existing media tag type %d block index entry at position %d, removing",
3040 tag_block.type, k);
3041 utarray_erase(ctx->index_entries, k, 1);
3042 }
3043 }
3044
3045 // Add media tag block to index
3046 TRACE("Adding media tag type %d block to index", tag_block.type);
3047 IndexEntry tag_index_entry;
3048 tag_index_entry.blockType = DataBlock;
3049 tag_index_entry.dataType = tag_block.type;
3050 tag_index_entry.offset = tag_position;
3051 utarray_push_back(ctx->index_entries, &tag_index_entry);
3052 ctx->dirty_index_block = true;
3053 TRACE("Added media tag block type %d index entry at offset %" PRIu64, tag_block.type, tag_position);
3054 }
3055 }
3056
3057 if(tag_block.compression != kCompressionNone) free(buffer);
3058 }
3059}

3223static void write_tape_file_block(aaruformat_context *ctx)
3224{
3225 if(ctx->tape_files == NULL) return;
3226
3227 // Iterate the uthash and count how many entries do we have
3228 const tapeFileHashEntry *tape_file = NULL;
3229 const tapeFileHashEntry *tmp_tape_file = NULL;
3230 size_t tape_file_count = 0;
3231 HASH_ITER(hh, ctx->tape_files, tape_file, tmp_tape_file) tape_file_count++;
3232
3233 // Create a memory buffer to copy all the file entries
3234 const size_t buffer_size = tape_file_count * sizeof(TapeFileEntry);
3235 TapeFileEntry *buffer = malloc(buffer_size);
3236 if(buffer == NULL)
3237 {
3238 TRACE("Failed to allocate memory for tape file entries");
3239 return;
3240 }
3241 memset(buffer, 0, buffer_size);
3242 size_t index = 0;
3243 HASH_ITER(hh, ctx->tape_files, tape_file, tmp_tape_file)
3244 {
3245 if(index >= tape_file_count) break;
3246 memcpy(&buffer[index], &tape_file->fileEntry, sizeof(TapeFileEntry));
3247 index++;
3248 }
3249
3250 // Create the tape file block in memory
3251 TapeFileHeader tape_file_block = {0};
3252 tape_file_block.identifier = TapeFileBlock;
3253 tape_file_block.length = (uint32_t)buffer_size;
3254 tape_file_block.crc64 = aaruf_crc64_data((uint8_t *)buffer, (uint32_t)tape_file_block.length);
3255
3256 // Write tape file block to file, block aligned
3257 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, 0, SEEK_END);
3258 aaru_off_t block_position = aaruf_ftell(ctx->imageStream);
3259 const uint64_t alignment_mask = (1ULL << ctx->user_data_ddt_header.blockAlignmentShift) - 1;
3260 if(block_position & alignment_mask)
3261 {
3262 const uint64_t aligned_position = block_position + alignment_mask & ~alignment_mask;
3263 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, aligned_position, SEEK_SET);
3264 block_position = aligned_position;
3265 }
3266 TRACE("Writing tape file block at position %ld", block_position);
3267 if(fwrite(&tape_file_block, sizeof(TapeFileHeader), 1, ctx->imageStream) == 1)
3268 {
3269 const size_t written_bytes = fwrite(buffer, tape_file_block.length, 1, ctx->imageStream);
3270 if(written_bytes == 1)
3271 {
3272 TRACE("Successfully wrote tape file block (%" PRIu64 " bytes)", tape_file_block.length);
3273
3274 // Remove any previously existing index entries of the same type before adding
3275 TRACE("Removing any previously existing tape file block index entries");
3276 for(int k = utarray_len(ctx->index_entries) - 1; k >= 0; k--)
3277 {
3278 const IndexEntry *entry = (IndexEntry *)utarray_eltptr(ctx->index_entries, k);
3279 if(entry && entry->blockType == TapeFileBlock && entry->dataType == 0)
3280 {
3281 TRACE("Found existing tape file block index entry at position %d, removing", k);
3282 utarray_erase(ctx->index_entries, k, 1);
3283 }
3284 }
3285
3286 // Add tape file block to index
3287 TRACE("Adding tape file block to index");
3288 IndexEntry index_entry;
3289 index_entry.blockType = TapeFileBlock;
3290 index_entry.dataType = 0;
3291 index_entry.offset = block_position;
3292 utarray_push_back(ctx->index_entries, &index_entry);
3293 ctx->dirty_index_block = true;
3294 TRACE("Added tape file block index entry at offset %" PRIu64, block_position);
3295 }
3296 }
3297
3298 free(buffer);
3299}

4055static void write_dumphw_block(aaruformat_context *ctx)
4056{
4057
4058 if(ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data == NULL || ctx->dump_hardware_header.entries == 0 ||
4059 ctx->dump_hardware_header.identifier != DumpHardwareBlock)
4060 return;
4061
4062 const size_t required_length = sizeof(DumpHardwareHeader) + ctx->dump_hardware_header.length;
4063
4064 uint8_t *buffer = calloc(1, required_length);
4065
4066 if(buffer == NULL) return;
4067
4068 // Start to iterate and copy the data
4069 size_t offset = sizeof(DumpHardwareHeader);
4070 for(int i = 0; i < ctx->dump_hardware_header.entries; i++)
4071 {
4072 size_t entry_size = sizeof(DumpHardwareEntry) +
4073 ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.manufacturerLength +
4074 ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.modelLength +
4075 ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.revisionLength +
4076 ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.firmwareLength +
4077 ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.serialLength +
4078 ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.softwareNameLength +
4079 ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.softwareVersionLength +
4080 ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.softwareOperatingSystemLength +
4081 ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.extents * sizeof(DumpExtent);
4082
4083 if(offset + entry_size > required_length)
4084 {
4085 FATAL("Calculated size exceeds provided buffer length");
4086 free(buffer);
4087 return;
4088 }
4089
4090 memcpy(buffer + offset, &ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry, sizeof(DumpHardwareEntry));
4091 offset += sizeof(DumpHardwareEntry);
4092 if(ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.manufacturerLength > 0 &&
4093 ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].manufacturer != NULL)
4094 {
4095 memcpy(buffer + offset, ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].manufacturer,
4096 ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.manufacturerLength);
4097 offset += ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.manufacturerLength;
4098 }
4099 if(ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.modelLength > 0 &&
4100 ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].model != NULL)
4101 {
4102 memcpy(buffer + offset, ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].model,
4103 ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.modelLength);
4104 offset += ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.modelLength;
4105 }
4106 if(ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.revisionLength > 0 &&
4107 ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].revision != NULL)
4108 {
4109 memcpy(buffer + offset, ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].revision,
4110 ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.revisionLength);
4111 offset += ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.revisionLength;
4112 }
4113 if(ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.firmwareLength > 0 &&
4114 ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].firmware != NULL)
4115 {
4116 memcpy(buffer + offset, ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].firmware,
4117 ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.firmwareLength);
4118 offset += ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.firmwareLength;
4119 }
4120 if(ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.serialLength > 0 &&
4121 ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].serial != NULL)
4122 {
4123 memcpy(buffer + offset, ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].serial,
4124 ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.serialLength);
4125 offset += ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.serialLength;
4126 }
4127 if(ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.softwareNameLength > 0 &&
4128 ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].softwareName != NULL)
4129 {
4130 memcpy(buffer + offset, ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].softwareName,
4131 ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.softwareNameLength);
4132 offset += ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.softwareNameLength;
4133 }
4134 if(ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.softwareVersionLength > 0 &&
4135 ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].softwareVersion != NULL)
4136 {
4137 memcpy(buffer + offset, ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].softwareVersion,
4138 ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.softwareVersionLength);
4139 offset += ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.softwareVersionLength;
4140 }
4141 if(ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.softwareOperatingSystemLength > 0 &&
4142 ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].softwareOperatingSystem != NULL)
4143 {
4144 memcpy(buffer + offset, ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].softwareOperatingSystem,
4145 ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.softwareOperatingSystemLength);
4146 offset += ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.softwareOperatingSystemLength;
4147 }
4148 if(ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.extents > 0 &&
4149 ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].extents != NULL)
4150 {
4151 memcpy(buffer + offset, ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].extents,
4152 ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.extents * sizeof(DumpExtent));
4153 offset += ctx->dump_hardware_entries_with_data[i].entry.extents * sizeof(DumpExtent);
4154 }
4155 }
4156
4157 // Calculate CRC64
4158 ctx->dump_hardware_header.crc64 =
4159 aaruf_crc64_data(buffer + sizeof(DumpHardwareHeader), ctx->dump_hardware_header.length);
4160
4161 // Copy header
4162 memcpy(buffer, &ctx->dump_hardware_header, sizeof(DumpHardwareHeader));
4163
4164 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, 0, SEEK_END);
4165 aaru_off_t block_position = aaruf_ftell(ctx->imageStream);
4166 const uint64_t alignment_mask = (1ULL << ctx->user_data_ddt_header.blockAlignmentShift) - 1;
4167 if(block_position & alignment_mask)
4168 {
4169 const uint64_t aligned_position = block_position + alignment_mask & ~alignment_mask;
4170 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, aligned_position, SEEK_SET);
4171 block_position = aligned_position;
4172 }
4173 TRACE("Writing dump hardware block at position %ld", block_position);
4174 if(fwrite(buffer, required_length, 1, ctx->imageStream) == 1)
4175 {
4176 TRACE("Successfully wrote dump hardware block");
4177
4178 // Remove any previously existing index entries of the same type before adding
4179 TRACE("Removing any previously existing dump hardware block index entries");
4180 for(int k = utarray_len(ctx->index_entries) - 1; k >= 0; k--)
4181 {
4182 const IndexEntry *entry = (IndexEntry *)utarray_eltptr(ctx->index_entries, k);
4183 if(entry && entry->blockType == DumpHardwareBlock && entry->dataType == 0)
4184 {
4185 TRACE("Found existing dump hardware block index entry at position %d, removing", k);
4186 utarray_erase(ctx->index_entries, k, 1);
4187 }
4188 }
4189
4190 // Add dump hardware block to index
4191 TRACE("Adding dump hardware block to index");
4192 IndexEntry index_entry;
4193 index_entry.blockType = DumpHardwareBlock;
4194 index_entry.dataType = 0;
4195 index_entry.offset = block_position;
4196 utarray_push_back(ctx->index_entries, &index_entry);
4197 ctx->dirty_index_block = true;
4198 TRACE("Added dump hardware block index entry at offset %" PRIu64, block_position);
4199 }
4200
4201 free(buffer);
4202}
