4752static int32_t write_flux_capture_payload(aaruformat_context *ctx, FluxCaptureRecord *record, FluxEntry *entry)
4753{
4754 uint64_t data_length = record->data_length;
4755 uint64_t index_length = record->index_length;
4756 uint64_t raw_length = data_length + index_length;
4757
4758 if(raw_length > UINT32_MAX)
4759 {
4760 FATAL("Flux capture raw length exceeds 32-bit limit (%" PRIu64 ")", raw_length);
4761 return AARUF_ERROR_INCORRECT_DATA_SIZE;
4762 }
4763
4764 uint8_t *raw_buffer = NULL;
4765 if(raw_length != 0)
4766 {
4767 raw_buffer = malloc(raw_length);
4768 if(raw_buffer == NULL)
4769 {
4770 FATAL("Could not allocate %" PRIu64 " bytes for flux serialization", raw_length);
4771 return AARUF_ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY;
4772 }
4773
4774 if(data_length != 0 && record->data_buffer != NULL) memcpy(raw_buffer, record->data_buffer, data_length);
4775 if(index_length != 0 && record->index_buffer != NULL)
4776 memcpy(raw_buffer + data_length, record->index_buffer, index_length);
4777 }
4778
4779 uint64_t raw_crc = raw_length != 0 && raw_buffer != NULL ? aaruf_crc64_data(raw_buffer, raw_length) : 0;
4780
4781 CompressionType compression =
4782 ctx->compression_enabled ? (ctx->use_zstd ? kCompressionZstd : kCompressionLzma) : kCompressionNone;
4783
4784 uint8_t *compressed_buffer = NULL;
4785 uint32_t cmp_length = 0;
4786 uint64_t cmp_crc = 0;
4787
4788 if(compression == kCompressionLzma)
4789 {
4790 size_t cmp_capacity = raw_length ? raw_length * 2 + 65536 : LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH + 16;
4791 if(cmp_capacity < raw_length + LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH) cmp_capacity = raw_length + LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH;
4792
4793 uint8_t *cmp_stream = malloc(cmp_capacity);
4794 if(cmp_stream == NULL)
4795 {
4796 free(raw_buffer);
4797 FATAL("Could not allocate %zu bytes for LZMA flux compression", cmp_capacity);
4798 return AARUF_ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY;
4799 }
4800
4801 size_t dst_size = cmp_capacity;
4802 uint8_t lzma_props[LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH] = {0};
4803 size_t props_size = LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH;
4804 int32_t error_no = aaruf_lzma_encode_buffer(cmp_stream, &dst_size, raw_buffer, raw_length, lzma_props,
4805 &props_size, 9, ctx->lzma_dict_size, 4, 0, 2, 273, LZMA_THREADS(ctx));
4806
4807 if(error_no != 0 || props_size != LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH || dst_size >= raw_length)
4808 {
4809 TRACE("Flux capture compression fell back to uncompressed (err=%d, dst=%zu, raw=%" PRIu64 ")", error_no,
4810 dst_size, raw_length);
4811 compression = kCompressionNone;
4812 free(cmp_stream);
4813 }
4814 else
4815 {
4816 cmp_length = (uint32_t)(dst_size + LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH);
4817 compressed_buffer = malloc(cmp_length);
4818 if(compressed_buffer == NULL)
4819 {
4820 free(cmp_stream);
4821 free(raw_buffer);
4822 FATAL("Could not allocate %u bytes for flux compressed payload", cmp_length);
4823 return AARUF_ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY;
4824 }
4825
4826 memcpy(compressed_buffer, lzma_props, LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH);
4827 memcpy(compressed_buffer + LZMA_PROPERTIES_LENGTH, cmp_stream, dst_size);
4828 cmp_crc = aaruf_crc64_data(compressed_buffer, cmp_length);
4829 free(cmp_stream);
4830 free(raw_buffer);
4831 raw_buffer = NULL;
4832 }
4833 }
4834 else if(compression == kCompressionZstd)
4835 {
4836 size_t cmp_capacity = raw_length ? raw_length * 2 + 65536 : 16;
4837
4838 uint8_t *cmp_stream = malloc(cmp_capacity);
4839 if(cmp_stream == NULL)
4840 {
4841 free(raw_buffer);
4842 FATAL("Could not allocate %zu bytes for zstd flux compression", cmp_capacity);
4843 return AARUF_ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY;
4844 }
4845
4846 size_t dst_size =
4847 aaruf_zstd_encode_buffer(cmp_stream, cmp_capacity, raw_buffer, raw_length, ctx->zstd_level, ctx->num_threads);
4848
4849 if(dst_size == 0 || dst_size >= raw_length)
4850 {
4851 TRACE("Flux capture zstd compression fell back to uncompressed (dst=%zu, raw=%" PRIu64 ")", dst_size,
4852 raw_length);
4853 compression = kCompressionNone;
4854 free(cmp_stream);
4855 }
4856 else
4857 {
4858 cmp_length = (uint32_t)dst_size;
4859 compressed_buffer = cmp_stream;
4860 cmp_crc = aaruf_crc64_data(compressed_buffer, cmp_length);
4861 ctx->has_zstd_blocks = true;
4862 free(raw_buffer);
4863 raw_buffer = NULL;
4864 }
4865 }
4866
4867 if(compression == kCompressionNone)
4868 {
4869 cmp_length = (uint32_t)raw_length;
4870 cmp_crc = raw_crc;
4871 compressed_buffer = raw_buffer;
4872 raw_buffer = NULL;
4873 }
4874
4875 // Align stream position to block boundary
4876 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, 0, SEEK_END);
4877 aaru_off_t payload_position = aaruf_ftell(ctx->imageStream);
4878 const uint64_t alignment_mask = (1ULL << ctx->user_data_ddt_header.blockAlignmentShift) - 1;
4879 if(payload_position & alignment_mask)
4880 {
4881 const uint64_t aligned_position = payload_position + alignment_mask & ~alignment_mask;
4882 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, aligned_position, SEEK_SET);
4883 payload_position = aligned_position;
4884 }
4885
4886 DataStreamPayloadHeader payload_header = {0};
4887 payload_header.identifier = DataStreamPayloadBlock;
4888 payload_header.dataType = kDataTypeFluxData;
4889 payload_header.compression = (uint16_t)compression;
4890 payload_header.cmpLength = cmp_length;
4891 payload_header.length = (uint32_t)raw_length;
4892 payload_header.cmpCrc64 = cmp_crc;
4893 payload_header.crc64 = raw_crc;
4894
4895 if(fwrite(&payload_header, sizeof(DataStreamPayloadHeader), 1, ctx->imageStream) != 1)
4896 {
4897 free(compressed_buffer);
4898 free(raw_buffer);
4899 FATAL("Could not write flux payload header");
4900 return AARUF_ERROR_CANNOT_WRITE_BLOCK_HEADER;
4901 }
4902
4903 if(cmp_length != 0 && compressed_buffer != NULL && fwrite(compressed_buffer, cmp_length, 1, ctx->imageStream) != 1)
4904 {
4905 free(compressed_buffer);
4906 free(raw_buffer);
4907 FATAL("Could not write flux payload data");
4908 return AARUF_ERROR_CANNOT_WRITE_BLOCK_DATA;
4909 }
4910
4911 IndexEntry payload_entry;
4912 payload_entry.blockType = DataStreamPayloadBlock;
4913 payload_entry.dataType = kDataTypeFluxData;
4914 payload_entry.offset = payload_position;
4915 utarray_push_back(ctx->index_entries, &payload_entry);
4916
4917 entry->head = record->entry.head;
4918 entry->track = record->entry.track;
4919 entry->subtrack = record->entry.subtrack;
4920 entry->captureIndex = record->entry.captureIndex;
4921 entry->dataResolution = record->entry.dataResolution;
4922 entry->indexResolution = record->entry.indexResolution;
4923 entry->indexOffset = record->data_length;
4924 entry->payloadOffset = payload_position >> ctx->user_data_ddt_header.blockAlignmentShift;
4925
4926 record->entry = *entry;
4927
4928 free(compressed_buffer);
4929 free(raw_buffer);
4930
4931 return AARUF_STATUS_OK;
4932}
4933
5167static int32_t write_flux_blocks(aaruformat_context *ctx)
5168{
5169 TRACE("Entering write_flux_blocks(%p)", ctx);
5170
5171 if(ctx == NULL || ctx->imageStream == NULL)
5172 {
5173 FATAL("Invalid context when writing flux blocks");
5174 return AARUF_ERROR_NOT_AARUFORMAT;
5175 }
5176
5177 if(ctx->flux_captures == NULL || utarray_len(ctx->flux_captures) == 0)
5178 {
5179 TRACE("No flux captures enqueued, skipping flux block serialization");
5180 return AARUF_STATUS_OK;
5181 }
5182
5183 size_t capture_count = utarray_len(ctx->flux_captures);
5184 if(capture_count > UINT16_MAX)
5185 {
5186 FATAL("Flux capture count exceeds header capacity (%zu > %u)", capture_count, UINT16_MAX);
5187 return AARUF_ERROR_INCORRECT_DATA_SIZE;
5188 }
5189
5190 FluxEntry *previous_entries = ctx->flux_entries;
5191 ctx->flux_entries = NULL;
5192
5193 FluxEntry *entries = malloc(capture_count * sizeof(FluxEntry));
5194 if(entries == NULL)
5195 {
5196 ctx->flux_entries = previous_entries;
5197 FATAL("Could not allocate %zu bytes for flux entries", capture_count * sizeof(FluxEntry));
5198 return AARUF_ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY;
5199 }
5200
5201 size_t idx = 0;
5202 for(FluxCaptureRecord *record = (FluxCaptureRecord *)utarray_front(ctx->flux_captures); record != NULL;
5203 record = (FluxCaptureRecord *)utarray_next(ctx->flux_captures, record), ++idx)
5204 {
5205 int32_t res = write_flux_capture_payload(ctx, record, &entries[idx]);
5206 if(res != AARUF_STATUS_OK)
5207 {
5208 free(entries);
5209 ctx->flux_entries = previous_entries;
5210 return res;
5211 }
5212 }
5213
5214 FluxHeader header = {0};
5215 header.identifier = FluxDataBlock;
5216 header.entries = (uint16_t)capture_count;
5217 header.blockAlignmentShift = ctx->user_data_ddt_header.blockAlignmentShift;
5218 header.crc64 =
5219 capture_count == 0 ? 0 : aaruf_crc64_data((const uint8_t *)entries, capture_count * sizeof(FluxEntry));
5220
5221 // Align stream position to block boundary
5222 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, 0, SEEK_END);
5223 aaru_off_t metadata_position = aaruf_ftell(ctx->imageStream);
5224 const uint64_t alignment_mask = (1ULL << ctx->user_data_ddt_header.blockAlignmentShift) - 1;
5225 if(metadata_position & alignment_mask)
5226 {
5227 const uint64_t aligned_position = metadata_position + alignment_mask & ~alignment_mask;
5228 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, aligned_position, SEEK_SET);
5229 metadata_position = aligned_position;
5230 }
5231
5232 if(fwrite(&header, sizeof(FluxHeader), 1, ctx->imageStream) != 1)
5233 {
5234 free(entries);
5235 ctx->flux_entries = previous_entries;
5236 FATAL("Could not write flux metadata header");
5237 return AARUF_ERROR_CANNOT_WRITE_BLOCK_HEADER;
5238 }
5239
5240 if(capture_count != 0)
5241 {
5242 size_t written_entries = fwrite(entries, sizeof(FluxEntry), capture_count, ctx->imageStream);
5243 if(written_entries != capture_count)
5244 {
5245 free(entries);
5246 ctx->flux_entries = previous_entries;
5247 FATAL("Could not write %zu flux entries (wrote %zu)", capture_count, written_entries);
5248 return AARUF_ERROR_CANNOT_WRITE_BLOCK_DATA;
5249 }
5250 }
5251
5252 IndexEntry metadata_entry;
5253 metadata_entry.blockType = FluxDataBlock;
5254 metadata_entry.dataType = 0;
5255 metadata_entry.offset = metadata_position;
5256 utarray_push_back(ctx->index_entries, &metadata_entry);
5257
5258 if(previous_entries != NULL) free(previous_entries);
5259 ctx->flux_entries = entries;
5260 ctx->flux_data_header = header;
5261
5262 utarray_free(ctx->flux_captures);
5263 ctx->flux_captures = NULL;
5264
5265 int32_t map_result = flux_map_rebuild_from_entries(ctx);
5266 if(map_result != AARUF_STATUS_OK) return map_result;
5267
5268 TRACE("Wrote %zu flux captures", capture_count);
5269 return AARUF_STATUS_OK;
5270}
5271
5288static int32_t write_index_block(aaruformat_context *ctx)
5289{
5290 // Write the complete index at the end of the file
5291 TRACE("Writing index at the end of the file");
5292 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, 0, SEEK_END);
5293 aaru_off_t index_position = aaruf_ftell(ctx->imageStream);
5294
5295 // Align index position to block boundary if needed
5296 uint64_t alignment_mask = (1ULL << ctx->user_data_ddt_header.blockAlignmentShift) - 1;
5297 if(index_position & alignment_mask)
5298 {
5299 uint64_t aligned_position = index_position + alignment_mask & ~alignment_mask;
5300 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, aligned_position, SEEK_SET);
5301 index_position = aligned_position;
5302 TRACE("Aligned index position to %" PRIu64, aligned_position);
5303 }
5304
5305 // Prepare index header
5306 IndexHeader3 index_header;
5307 index_header.identifier = IndexBlock3;
5308 index_header.entries = utarray_len(ctx->index_entries);
5309 index_header.previous = 0; // No previous index for now
5310
5311 TRACE("Writing index with %" PRIu64 " entries at position %ld", index_header.entries, index_position);
5312
5313 // Calculate CRC64 of index entries
5314 crc64_ctx *index_crc64_context = aaruf_crc64_init();
5315 if(index_crc64_context != NULL && index_header.entries > 0)
5316 {
5317 size_t index_data_size = index_header.entries * sizeof(IndexEntry);
5318 aaruf_crc64_update(index_crc64_context, utarray_front(ctx->index_entries), index_data_size);
5319 aaruf_crc64_final(index_crc64_context, &index_header.crc64);
5320 TRACE("Calculated index CRC64: 0x%16lX", index_header.crc64);
5321 }
5322 else
5323 index_header.crc64 = 0;
5324
5325 // Free CRC64 context
5326 aaruf_crc64_free(index_crc64_context);
5327
5328 // Write index header
5329 if(fwrite(&index_header, sizeof(IndexHeader3), 1, ctx->imageStream) == 1)
5330 {
5331 TRACE("Successfully wrote index header");
5332
5333 // Write index entries
5334 if(index_header.entries > 0)
5335 {
5336 size_t entries_written = 0;
5337 IndexEntry *entry = NULL;
5338
5339 for(entry = (IndexEntry *)utarray_front(ctx->index_entries); entry != NULL;
5340 entry = (IndexEntry *)utarray_next(ctx->index_entries, entry))
5341 if(fwrite(entry, sizeof(IndexEntry), 1, ctx->imageStream) == 1)
5342 {
5343 entries_written++;
5344 TRACE("Wrote index entry: blockType=0x%08X dataType=%u offset=%" PRIu64, entry->blockType,
5345 entry->dataType, entry->offset);
5346 }
5347 else
5348 {
5349 TRACE("Failed to write index entry %zu", entries_written);
5350 break;
5351 }
5352
5353 if(entries_written == index_header.entries)
5354 {
5355 TRACE("Successfully wrote all %zu index entries", entries_written);
5356
5357 // Update header with index offset and rewrite it
5358 ctx->header.indexOffset = index_position;
5359 TRACE("Updating header with index offset: %" PRIu64, ctx->header.indexOffset);
5360
5361 // Seek back to beginning and rewrite header
5362 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, 0, SEEK_SET);
5363 if(fwrite(&ctx->header, sizeof(AaruHeaderV2), 1, ctx->imageStream) == 1)
5364 TRACE("Successfully updated header with index offset");
5365 else
5366 {
5367 TRACE("Failed to update header with index offset");
5368 return AARUF_ERROR_CANNOT_WRITE_HEADER;
5369 }
5370 }
5371 else
5372 {
5373 TRACE("Failed to write all index entries (wrote %zu of %" PRIu64 ")", entries_written,
5374 index_header.entries);
5375 return AARUF_ERROR_CANNOT_WRITE_HEADER;
5376 }
5377 }
5378 }
5379 else
5380 {
5381 TRACE("Failed to write index header");
5382 return AARUF_ERROR_CANNOT_WRITE_HEADER;
5383 }
5384
5385 return AARUF_STATUS_OK;
5386}

5400int32_t aaruf_finalize_write(aaruformat_context *ctx)
5401{
5402 TRACE("File is writing");
5403
5404 if(ctx->has_zstd_blocks) ctx->header.featureIncompatible |= AARU_FEATURE_INCOMPAT_ZSTD;
5405
5406 TRACE("Seeking to start of image");
5407 // Write the header at the beginning of the file
5408 aaruf_fseek(ctx->imageStream, 0, SEEK_SET);
5409
5410 TRACE("Writing header at position 0");
5411 if(fwrite(&ctx->header, sizeof(AaruHeaderV2), 1, ctx->imageStream) != 1)
5412 {
5413 fclose(ctx->imageStream);
5414 ctx->imageStream = NULL;
5415 errno = AARUF_ERROR_CANNOT_WRITE_HEADER;
5416 return -1;
5417 }
5418
5419 // Close current block first
5420 TRACE("Closing current block if any");
5421 if(ctx->writing_buffer != NULL)
5422 {
5423 int error = aaruf_close_current_block(ctx);
5424
5425 if(error != AARUF_STATUS_OK) return error;
5426 }
5427
5428 int32_t res;
5429 if(ctx->is_tape)
5430 {
5431 // Write tape DDT
5432 if(ctx->dirty_tape_ddt)
5433 {
5434 res = write_tape_ddt(ctx);
5435 if(res != AARUF_STATUS_OK) return res;
5436 }
5437 }
5438 else
5439 {
5440 // Write cached secondary DDT table if any
5441 if(ctx->dirty_secondary_ddt)
5442 {
5443 res = write_cached_secondary_ddt(ctx);
5444 if(res != AARUF_STATUS_OK) return res;
5445 }
5446
5447 // Write primary DDT table (multi-level) if applicable
5448 if(ctx->dirty_primary_ddt)
5449 {
5450 res = write_primary_ddt(ctx);
5451 if(res != AARUF_STATUS_OK) return res;
5452 }
5453
5454 // Write single-level DDT table if applicable
5455 if(ctx->dirty_single_level_ddt)
5456 {
5457 res = write_single_level_ddt(ctx);
5458 if(res != AARUF_STATUS_OK) return res;
5459 }
5460 }
5461
5462 // Write twin sector table (after the DDTs, which already carry the Twin statuses)
5463 if(ctx->dirty_twin_table)
5464 {
5465 res = write_twin_sector_table(ctx);
5466 if(res != AARUF_STATUS_OK) return res;
5467 }
5468
5469 // Finalize checksums and write checksum block
5470 if(ctx->dirty_checksum_block) write_checksum_block(ctx);
5471
5472 // Write tracks block
5473 if(ctx->dirty_tracks_block) write_tracks_block(ctx);
5474
5475 // Write flux capture blocks
5476 if(ctx->dirty_flux_block)
5477 {
5478 res = write_flux_blocks(ctx);
5479 if(res != AARUF_STATUS_OK) return res;
5480 }
5481
5482 // Write MODE 2 subheader data block
5483 if(ctx->dirty_mode2_subheaders_block) write_mode2_subheaders_block(ctx);
5484
5485 // Write CD sector prefix data block
5486 if(ctx->dirty_sector_prefix_block) write_sector_prefix(ctx);
5487
5488 // Write sector prefix DDT (statuses + optional indexes)
5489 if(ctx->dirty_sector_prefix_ddt) write_sector_prefix_ddt(ctx);
5490
5491 // Write CD sector suffix data block (EDC/ECC captures)
5492 if(ctx->dirty_sector_suffix_block) write_sector_suffix(ctx);
5493
5494 // Write sector prefix DDT (EDC/ECC captures)
5495 if(ctx->dirty_sector_suffix_ddt) write_sector_suffix_ddt(ctx);
5496
5497 // Write sector subchannel data block
5498 if(ctx->dirty_sector_subchannel_block) write_sector_subchannel(ctx);
5499
5500 // Write DVD long sector data blocks
5501 if(ctx->dirty_dvd_long_sector_blocks) write_dvd_long_sector_blocks(ctx);
5502
5503 // Write Blu-ray sector EDC block (long sectors)
5504 if(ctx->dirty_bd_sector_edc_block) write_bd_sector_edc_block(ctx);
5505
5506 // Write DVD decrypted title keys
5507 if(ctx->dirty_dvd_title_key_decrypted_block) write_dvd_title_key_decrypted_block(ctx);
5508
5509 // Write media tags data blocks
5510 if(ctx->dirty_media_tags) write_media_tags(ctx);
5511
5512 // Write tape files
5513 if(ctx->dirty_tape_file_block) write_tape_file_block(ctx);
5514
5515 // Write tape partitions
5516 if(ctx->dirty_tape_partition_block) write_tape_partition_block(ctx);
5517
5518 // Write geometry block if any
5519 if(ctx->dirty_geometry_block) write_geometry_block(ctx);
5520
5521 // Write metadata block
5522 if(ctx->dirty_metadata_block) write_metadata_block(ctx);
5523
5524 // Write dump hardware block if any
5525 if(ctx->dirty_dumphw_block) write_dumphw_block(ctx);
5526
5527 // Write CICM XML block if any
5528 if(ctx->dirty_cicm_block) write_cicm_block(ctx);
5529
5530 // Write Aaru metadata JSON block if any
5531 if(ctx->dirty_json_block) write_aaru_json_block(ctx);
5532
5533 // Write Data Position Measurement block
5534 if(ctx->dirty_dpm_block) write_dpm_block(ctx);
5535
5536 // Write the complete index at the end of the file
5537 if(ctx->dirty_index_block)
5538 {
5539 res = write_index_block(ctx);
5540 if(res != AARUF_STATUS_OK) return res;
5541 }
5542
5543 // Write erasure coding parity, ECMB, and recovery footer
5544 ec_finalize(ctx);
5545
5546 if(ctx->deduplicate && ctx->sector_hash_map != NULL)
5547 {
5548 TRACE("Clearing sector hash map");
5549 // Clear sector hash map
5550 free_map(ctx->sector_hash_map);
5551 ctx->sector_hash_map = NULL;
5552 }
5553
5554 return AARUF_STATUS_OK;
5555}
